claims.summary: For a finite field F_q contained in K, v>=1 and 0<=k<v, the least degree of a nonzero f in K[x_1,...,x_v] whose formal restriction f(Ut+c) is zero for every rank-k U over F_q and c in F_q^v is q(q^(k+1)-1)/(q-1). A smallest-dimensional nonzero affine restriction is divisible by every rational affine hyperplane of that space; projecting to k+1 coordinates and multiplying all its affine hyperplane forms attains equality. Joint restriction is injective below that degree. Formal vanishing, not just finite-point evaluation; k=v has no nonzero example.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter minimal-restriction and explicit-product proof, passed by the sole medium reviewer. No efficient reconstruction or Frege lower bound asserted.
claims.rationale: Sharp general geometric calibration for a common-mask mechanism; point-vanishing and multiplicity results have distinct hypotheses.
claims.next_action: Use the exact mask threshold when assessing a collective affine-slice certificate invariant; do not infer global hardness from detection alone.

claims.summary: For a binary full certificate C and scalar patch C'=A+MC, if restriction to every binary affine k-flat fixes placeholders and gives rho(C')=rho(A), then any nonzero M has degree at least 2^(k+2)-2. A size-S depth-d division-free arithmetic circuit for M counting gates and wires, with scalar/variable leaves and no succinct powers, has S^d>=2^(k+2)-2. Fixed depth and k=omega(log N) exclude polynomial-size nonzero masks; for rank m=2n, k=n gives an exponential mask bound. Zero M, other patch forms and certificate/Frege size lower bounds are not excluded or proved.
claims.assessment: Working consequence of formal affine-flat vanishing and the elementary circuit-degree bound, passed by the sole medium reviewer. Scoped to nonzero common multipliers.
claims.rationale: At the rank candidate's parameters, rules out cheap simultaneous erasure by this nonzero scalar mask while leaving actual refutation complexity unchanged.
claims.next_action: Scheduled goal review must compare collective compatibility against alternative complete routes; this mask lower bound is not a refutation lower bound.
